sinopsis.es: MARTTEIN pasa sus días con su compañero haciendo música encerrados en su apartamento, hasta que una confesión global desata el caos en su contra. Comienzan a ser acechados por los vecinos que quieren irrumpir en su departamento y por los elementos extraños que envían los Estados Unidos hasta, también, su apartamento.
sinopsis.en: MARTTEIN spends his days making music with his partner, shut away in his apartment, until a global confession unleashes chaos against them. They begin to be stalked by neighbors trying to break into their apartment, as well as strange entities sent by the United States that also make their way into their home.
